EffectProfiles.definition: No creative distortion. Snippet cuts still use the Settings microfade.
Fade in and out. Fade duration range remains to be tuned.
Optional pitch shifts, reversal, and extra static. Do not force every effect each time.
Heavy randomized distortion. Final pitch ratio must never exceed 1.0.
Proposed profile: preserve voice clarity with light static and subtle pitch drift.
Heavier distortions and extra static always applied.

RadioSettings.definition: Version of these named-table definitions
Activity bounds are inclusive. >5 becomes 6 through 100.
Equal odds across eligible ambient sounds, after optional repeat filtering.
Small chance specified, exact number not supplied. One global event roll.
Time between ambient event checks.
Randomized recovery gap after a foreground sound.
Maximum recovery gap. Must be at least the minimum.
Avoid the last three ambient sound IDs when alternatives exist.
If all eligible sounds are recent, choose uniformly from the full eligible pool.
Ben responses and Creation use their exact response-pool odds.
On success, choose 1, 2 or 3 extra plays uniformly. Otherwise one play total.
Minimum pause between repetitions.
Maximum pause between repetitions.
Tiny start/end fades to suppress clicks at random snippet cut points.
If the source is shorter than the chosen duration, use available audio.
Choose duration first, then a random start that fits inside the source file.
Ignore capitalization and punctuation. Match whole words.
Hold SCAN to record. Evaluate voice_input when released.
Require detected speech/vocal input, including untranscribed vocalizations.
One rule outcome and at most one response sound per transmission.
One major sound at a time, layered over the channel static bed.
Themes for channels 4 and 6 do not invent keyword reactions absent from Files.
BenLifecycle defines when this clock starts, resets, and pauses.
Stop foreground playback and queued repeats when changing channels.
Skip missing audio. A failed Ben opening must not activate the session.
